mapper.select: SELECT s.uuid AS session_uuid, s.external_id AS session_external_id, s.organization_uuid, s.workspace_uuid, (s.archived_at IS NOT NULL OR s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS removed, COALESCE(CAST(cs.uuid AS text), '') AS code_session_uuid, COALESCE(cs.external_id, '') AS code_session_external_id, COALESCE(sandbox.provider_sandbox_id, '') AS provider_sandbox_id, COALESCE(sandbox.state, '') AS sandbox_state FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT code.uuid, code.external_id FROM code_sessions code WHERE code.organization_uuid = s.organization_uuid AND code.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid AND code.session_uuid = s.uuid AND code.status = 'active' AND code.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY code.created_at DESC, code.uuid DESC LIMIT 1 ) cs ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sb.provider_sandbox_id, sb.state FROM environment_work work JOIN environment_sandboxes sb ON sb.work_uuid = work.uuid AND sb.organization_uuid = work.organization_uuid AND sb.workspace_uuid = work.workspace_uuid AND sb.environment_uuid = work.environment_uuid WHERE work.organization_uuid = s.organization_uuid AND work.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid AND work.session_uuid = s.uuid AND work.state = 'active' AND work.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb.provider_sandbox_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sb.created_at DESC, sb.uuid DESC LIMIT 1 ) sandbox ON true WHERE s.uuid = #{sessionUUID}
